items.text: We must fight back & resist state-level attempts to make voting more difficult & oppose enactment of anti-democratic laws. I urge Gov. Ducey & the community to exercise caution to maintain public safety & keep people safe regardless of political views or party affiliation.

On Wednesday, I tested positive for COVID-19. I am vaccinated, boosted, experiencing mild symptoms and remain in good spirits. My staff and I will follow @CDCgov guidance on testing and quarantine procedures including notifying those who may have been in close contact.

Students shouldn't have to struggle to receive an education and worry about where they're going to sleep or where their next meal is going to come from. I look forward to working with the administration to ensure that we address barriers to educational access. (2/2)

It is crucial to protect animals from cruelty and abuse by enacting common sense policies. I am proud to have received a perfect score from the @HumaneSociety and will continue to fight for the humane treatment of animals. https://t.co/sTdz6nQg4x

Today's #GrijalvArt is from when I received my second dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. It's critical that we pass additional legislation to ensure we continue to provide funding to help constituents receive COVID testing, treatment and vaccine/booster shots. https://t.co/b7Za21PiOY

Clinica Amistad serves uninsured southern Arizonans who cannot qualify for government-assisted health care coverage. I was proud to secure Community Project Funding for Clinica for new health equipment and training. https://t.co/EyvsY6VuVP

Abortion providers and clinic staff offer courage, compassion, and high-quality care to patients and their families every day.
 
It's time we protect them with the same level of importance as our Supreme Court Justices. #HealthcareProvidersSafetyAct

Ahead of the first @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health in more than 50 years, @RepMcGovern and I introduced the Education and Training (EAT) for Health Act. #EATforHealth

https://t.co/qr8A1lzYzf

The #EATforHealth Act would increase nutrition education and awareness for health care professionals and ensure federal primary care health professionals have continuing education courses relating to nutrition. It would lower chronic health care costs through preventative care.

We must ensure that health care professionals are fully equipped and educated to provide well-rounded preventative care for patients including nutrition. I’m proud to introduce this legislation with @RepMcGovern that will lead to longer, healthier lives.

One of the main goals of the White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health is to integrate nutrition and health. 

That's why @RepMcGovern and I introduced the #EATforHealth Act to provide medical professionals recurring training in nutrition education and awareness.

The #EATforHealth Act will help increase preventative care and lower long-term health costs. It's critical that we provide up-to-date nutrition information for patients to help with disease prevention. 

https://t.co/qr8A1lzYzf
I'll continue to fight for individuals' freedoms at the federal level so health care decisions stay out of the hands of politicians and remain between patients and their doctors.

Each time Republicans have the opportunity to govern, including on January 6th, they are willing to drive the car off the bridge. These comments by Leader McCarthy to hold hostage critical benefits from Americans are more of the same.

https://t.co/YOxYJWg7ri

Republicans in Congress have offered no plan to address inflation except for raising taxes on millions of working and middle class Americans, repealing the ACA, and putting Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block.

https://t.co/ley5QKUf98

Love doesn't discriminate. 

Same-sex and interracial ​couples should not have to worry about whether their marriages will continue to enjoy equal treatment under federal law as do all other married couples. 

The Senate must pass the #RespectForMarriageAct into law. https://t.co/i5fKAQc3Oi

Open Enrollment for 2023 runs from November 1 through January 15, 2023. 

Enroll by December 15 for coverage that starts January 1!

https://t.co/mRz7274wSy

Medicare Open Enrollment ends tomorrow, Wednesday, December 7. Sign up today! 

https://t.co/JAP7FfWezk

When @HouseDemocrats were in charge, we elected a Speaker and passed into law the Inflation Reduction Act to lower costs for Americans and guarantee Medicare capped the price of insulin at $35 a month. 

So far, the @HouseGOP majority has delivered nothing but chaos.

Running tally of @HouseGOP "Commitment to America":

✂️slashing Social Security and Medicare
📉holding the full faith and credit of the U.S. hostage
💰protecting tax cheats and corporations

Seems like the commitment is just helping the rich get richer?

Insulin is capped at $35 for those on Medicare because Democrats passed the Inflation Reduction Act. With Big Pharma still price-gouging working people, we need to cap the price of insulin for all Americans. #SOTU

It's clear: Republicans want to hold the economy hostage unless we cut Medicare and Social Security. 

We won't let them. 

https://t.co/KnW9gYQPKv

Glad @POTUS got @HouseGOP on the record last night because the GOP has stated many times they want to sunset Social Security and Medicare. 

See page 19 of Sen. Rick Scott's plan which would do just that: 

All federal legislation sunsets in 5 years. 

https://t.co/0By6FVXnhY

In June, the Republican Study Committee released a budget plan that called for:

❌cutting Social Security benefits for anyone who retires before 70

❌raising the Medicare eligibility age to 70

❌scheduling the eligibility age for both programs to steadily increase over time

And all of this is over and above their proposed $3.3 trillion cut to Medicaid over 10 years.

https://t.co/gO6l7R5Zr6
